cards.body:
## Summary
The TV's D-pad is a 115-line closure with 22 branches that no test can reach, and 12 of 13 focusable screens write their focus layout twice - once in screens.tsx to draw `data-focused`, once in page.tsx to move and select. Extract it into `desk/src/tv/keys.ts`: `keyOf(e.key)`, `tvKey(session, key, local) -> { events, calls, local }` and one `stops(s)` list per screen that the renderer draws from, exactly as the profile screen (profileRows) and Linga (its actions list) already do.

## Description
page.tsx keeps only the executor: map the key, call tvKey, post the events in order, fire the calls, apply the local patch (and the call's onFail patch). The per-screen stop lists (landing, tonight via continueCard moved into `desk/src/tv/mathsRows.ts`, learner, essaytype from ESSAY_TYPES, playbook, hint, sentence, recap, topics, units, calendar, walk) are pure functions of the session; screens.tsx reads `stops[focus]` instead of re-counting. Two defects the extraction makes testable are fixed on the way: the stuck `busy` after a failed practice set, and the unguarded /api/hint on repeated Select. `lingaOwns(s)` replaces the four copies of the Linga predicate. Nothing is imported at runtime from lib/session/store or learners: types only.

## Flow
- keydown -> keyOf -> tvKey(s, key, {busy, table, hintInFlight}) -> {events, calls, local}
- runStep posts events in order, fires calls, applies local, and on a failed call applies its onFail patch
- screens.tsx: `const stops = tonightStops(s)` -> `data-focused={stops[focus] === 'teach'}`; the same list bounds the keymap's moves

## Expected impact
Every TV screen's navigation becomes a node:test case instead of a screenshot; a new screen or a new stop is one list edited, not two files kept in lockstep. The operator's /cx walk and the next challenge card on this surface (see slot B) can write key behaviour as failing tests first. Two live defects close: a failed set no longer freezes the topics screen, and a double press no longer spends two model calls and double-counts hints.

## Evaluation
Claim: the D-pad becomes one tested module and the duplicated focus layouts collapse to one list per screen.
Before: 0 of 8 acceptance cases pass (keys.ts and mathsRows.ts do not exist; cases 3 and 4 also describe behaviour today's handler gets wrong); 12 of 13 focusable screens duplicate their stops; 0 D-pad tests.
After: 8 of 8; 13 of 13 screens read one stop list; the keymap has a suite in test:rules.
Method: gate - acceptance cases written as failing tests first, then `cd desk && npm test`, plus the overlay's Playwright TV capture for a TV screen change.
Result: better
Gate: none

cards.body:
## Summary
When a practice set comes back marked, the TV drops the learner into item 1 of a one-at-a-time walk; how the set went is two numbers in a ticker, Back throws the set away, and doing six more on the same topic takes 4-7 presses through Tonight and Topics. Add a marked-sheet screen: the six verdicts as one picture, focus already on the first item to look at, Select opens that item in the walk, one action for six more on the same topic, one to put the sheet away - and Back parks the set so Tonight's continue card resumes it.

## Description
Store: Screen gains 'sheet'; practice.marked lands on 'sheet' with focus = the first wrong/unsure item (or the 'Six more' action when all are right). Pure logic in `desk/src/tv/sheetRows.ts`: sheetTiles (n, verdict, slip id - no text, no answer), sheetStops, firstToLook, sheetKey (the D-pad for sheet, walk and practice). continueCard moves to `desk/src/tv/mathsRows.ts` (shared with slot A) and gains the marked branch `go: 'sheet'`. The walk's Back and its last-item action return to the sheet at that item; the practice poster's Back parks instead of clearing. 'Six more' reuses topic.open + /api/practice exactly as Topics does, so the set is generated by the existing makeItems, already aimed at the learner's slips. The screen is On Air: a new band placement, six marks (right = white rule, look again = red block, unsure = dashed, as .verdict already draws them), the caption names the focused item, two actions, no prose outside the caption, no answers anywhere. If slot A lands first, sheetKey folds into tvKey and the cases are unchanged.

## Flow
- phone sends the worked sheet -> practice.marked -> TV on 'sheet', focus on the first slip
- Left/Right over the six marks, Select -> the walk at that item; Back from the walk -> the sheet at that item
- Down to the actions: 'Six more on <topic>' -> topic.open + /api/practice (Topics shows its existing preparing caption) ; 'Put the sheet away' -> practice.clear
- Back from the sheet or the poster -> Tonight, set kept; the continue card resumes it

## Expected impact
The learner sees in one glance which of the six went wrong, reaches a slip in one press instead of stepping through right answers, and closes the practice loop (mark -> look -> go again on the same topic) from the screen where the evidence is, in 2 presses instead of 4-7 plus the walk to the end. Leaving no longer destroys a marked set, so the continue card the screen already designed for resume becomes reachable.

## Evaluation
Claim: the marked set becomes a picture the learner acts on, the same-topic retry is one door, and Back parks instead of discarding.
Before: 0 of 8 acceptance cases pass (no 'sheet' screen, no sheetRows/mathsRows module, Back clears in page.tsx:178 and :184); presses from the last walked item to a new same-topic set: 4-7.
After: 8 of 8; presses from the sheet to a new same-topic set: 2 (Down, Select).
Method: gate - acceptance cases written as failing tests first, then `cd desk && npm test` and the overlay's Playwright TV capture.
Result: better
Gate: contract - the session's Screen union gains 'sheet' and practice.marked targets it. Consumers: desk/src/lib/session/store.ts (reduce, persisted session.json - an old 'walk' value stays valid), desk/src/app/tv/page.tsx (ScreenFor, keydown, the spoken line at :59), desk/src/app/phone/page.tsx (TV_WORDS :21-27, the talk-back check :275 stays on 'walk'), desk/src/english/LingaTV.tsx (navigates only to linga-*, pair, sentence - unaffected), uat/driver/linga-text.cjs (Linga screens only - unaffected). A new TV screen is inside the map description ('every TV screen, its rows and focus').
